info.title: MolMeDB: Molecules on Membranes Database
info.description: A database of molecules, membranes and their interactions (permeability, partitioning, binding), curated for membrane-transport research.

description.const: Xmin, the drug position with minimum energy in the membrane.
ΔGwat, the affinity towards the membrane.
LogK, the logarithm of the membrane-water partition coefficient.
LogPerm, the logarithm of the permeability coefficient.
Temperature of the measurement or calculation.
pKm, the negative decimal logarithm of the Michaelis constant Km.
pEC50, the negative decimal logarithm of the half maximal effective concentration.
pKi, the negative decimal logarithm of the inhibition constant Ki.
pIC50, the negative decimal logarithm of the half maximal inhibitory concentration.

type.description: Type of the interaction with the transporter, e.g. "Substrate" (pKm or pEC50 ≥ 5), "Non-substrate" (< 5), "Inhibitor" (pKi or pIC50 ≥ 5), "Non-inhibitor" (< 5).

charge.description: Charge of the measured form as recorded, e.g. "0", "+1", "-1".

km.description: pKm, the negative decimal logarithm of the Michaelis constant Km [M].

ec50.description: pEC50, the negative decimal logarithm of the half maximal effective concentration EC50 [M].

ki.description: pKi, the negative decimal logarithm of the inhibition constant Ki [M].

ic50.description: pIC50, the negative decimal logarithm of the half maximal inhibitory concentration IC50 [M].
